 Summary Statement

 Divestment of Publicly Traded Securities by the establishment of blind trust(s)

 Agreed Compliance Measures
 WHEREAS by reason of my appointment on July 15, 2020 as a federal reporting public office holder, I am subject to the Conflict of Interest Act (“Act”), including its prohibition on holding controlled assets (section 17). 
WHEREAS I have opted to divest my controlled assets, shares of 173217 Canada Inc. and my shares of 4381831 Canada Inc by placing them into a blind trust, in accordance with section 27 of the Act. 
WHEREAS 173217 Canada Inc. and 4381831 Canada Inc. (the corporations) are a private holding corporations that hold investments in controlled assets as defined by section 20 of the Act. 
AND WHEREAS pursuant to section 29 of the Act, the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner (Commissioner) has determined that the following additional compliance measures are required in order for me to comply with the requirements of the Act:
1. I shall not instruct, direct or advise the corporations’ directors, officers or shareholders or anyone else acting on the corporations’ behalf, with respect to the corporations’ controlled assets, including the management, disposition or investment of those assets. 
2. I shall refuse all requests for discussion, consultation, instruction, direction or advice by the corporations’ directors, officers, shareholders, or by anyone else acting on the corporations’ behalf, with respect to the corporation’s controlled assets. I will also refuse any information offered to me by the directors, officers, and shareholders of the corporation about the corporations’ controlled assets.
3. Any person or entity, including any director, officer, or shareholder of the corporation who communicates with me in respect of the corporations’ controlled assets shall be directed by me to the Trustee of my blind trust.
